```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dartRverse)
library(vcfR)
```

```{r}
gl <- gl.read.vcf('final.recode.vcf', ind.metafile = 'final_popmap.csv')
```
```{r}
pca <- gl.pcoa(gl)
```
```{r}
p <- gl.pcoa.plot(pca, gl)
p +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#04A3BDFF", "#F0BE3DFF", "#931E18FF", "#DA7901FF", "#247D3FFF", "#20235BFF", "#C0392BFF"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("pca_final_vcf.png", width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave("pca_final_vcf.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
```
